Retrieved via WebFetch 19 July 2026 ~17:55 BST. Liveblog entries, times in ET (ET+5 = BST).

~12:00 PM ET (~17:00 BST) — Secretary of State Marco Rubio met Lebanese President Joseph Aoun in Washington DC. Rubio "commended the courage of the Government of Lebanon" for efforts to "disarm Hezbollah and dismantle its terrorist infrastructure". Aoun scheduled to meet President Trump on Tuesday.

11:42 AM ET (16:42 BST) — Sen. Mark Warner (D-Virginia), top Democrat on Senate Intelligence Committee, on CBS "Face the Nation": US bases have been "on and off under attack" during the past five months. Warner: "It's remarkable in many ways that we've not had more casualties." Called the conflict "a war of choice" with no imminent Iranian threat when it began in February.

10:45 AM ET (15:45 BST) — Aoun's Washington visit is the first by a Lebanese head of state since Michel Sleiman met Barack Obama in 2009. Aoun planning discussions on strengthening the ceasefire and Israeli withdrawal.

09:06 AM ET (14:06 BST) — Israeli and Jordanian forces intercepted an Iranian missile targeting the Jordanian city of Aqaba. Jordanian military reported downing "three Iranian missiles".

08:29 AM ET (13:29 BST) — IDF identified missiles launched from Iran toward Aqaba and warned of potential "spillover into Israeli territory".

Headline: "Iran War Updates: U.S. concludes 8th straight night of strikes on Iran after Iranian attack kills 2 U.S. soldiers in Jordan"
